Rare Eurasian lynx spotted in Sikkim, confirming broader presence in eastern Himalayas

A rare Eurasian lynx has been photographed in Sikkim's Tso Lhamo plateau, marking the second photographic record of the species in the region. This finding follows a 2025 record in Arunachal Pradesh and highlights the need for conservation efforts to protect the wild cat's habitat.
